issuer: the licensing officers under the Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act

licence.name: driver's licence (motor vehicles other than motor cycles, hire cars, buses, lorries and tractors)

note: Read 2026-10-31 in the Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Cap. 51:02, in the Ministry of Legal Affairs' Laws of Guyana revision L.R.O. 1/2012 (amendments to Act 10 of 2008). S. 34(2): a person under seventeen shall not drive a motor vehicle other than a motor cycle or invalid carriage on a road ((3): eighteen for hire cars, buses, lorries and tractors), and (5) a person so prohibited by age is disqualified from holding or obtaining a licence to drive it; s. 29(1): the licensing officer grants a licence on payment of the prescribed fee; s. 29(3): a licence remains in force until the holder's birthday in the third year following the year of issue, a term between two and three years that the form's whole years can't hold, so the years are null. The fee is prescribed by regulation and the Guyana Revenue Authority's pages that give it answer this egress with a firewall block; it is null. Acts after 2008 (Act No. 7 of 2016, Bill 16 of 2018) were sought on parliament.gov.gy, which answered 403; the Ministry of Home Affairs' copy of the Act (L.R.O. 3/1998) reads the same in ss. 29 and 34. The issuer is named as the Act names it; that the Guyana Revenue Authority's offices act as its licensing officers wasn't read.
